scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Bowler integration. All earlier frozen references remain unmodified.
game_version: The frozen upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The dated secondary Bowler table identifies client build 18.600.3. Supercell's 2021 comparison note does not publish a current client build.

sources.title: A New Super Troop & More!
sources.limitations: It states that Super Bowler has one extra bounce for three damaging impacts, which establishes two impacts for the non-Super Bowler. It does not publish the normal Bowler's current build, bounce distance, splash radius, collision, flight or timing.

sources.title: Bowler - Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: The dated table gives L1-L10 HP and DPS, ground targeting, 2.2-second cadence and 3-tile range. Its description says the boulder damages its target then a second building behind it, but does not quantify the second-impact geometry or timing.

damage_per_shot.derivation: 160 DPS multiplied by the dated 2.2-second cadence. Replace if a versioned cadence changes.

bounce_impact_count.note: The official comparison calls Super Bowler's one extra bounce three damaging impacts in total, establishing two impacts for the ordinary Bowler.

bounce_step_tiles.note: Documented deterministic proxy only. Core reuses the dated 3-tile initial range as the forward step because no measured current bounce path is public.

support.note: Core serializes two ground fixed impacts on the initial target ray. The two-impact count and forward second building are sourced. The step, zero-radius lower bound, flight, collision and target-loss behavior remain incomplete.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only. The frozen payload reported L10 as 850 HP and 156 DPS with no bounce contract.
changed_values.replacement: L10 is corrected to 860 HP, 160 DPS and 352 damage per shot from the dated current-build table. Core emits two serialized impacts per sourced boulder attack.
changed_values.justification: The historical payload is preserved. The current values and double-impact behavior are added through this dated, hash-pinned delta.

known_uncertainties: No source located defines exact normal-Bowler bounce spacing, bounce target acquisition, collision width, splash radius, target loss, flight, bounce delay, walls or tick ordering.
Core's 3-tile forward step is a dated-range proxy. Its zero-radius second impact intentionally models only a building centered at the documented forward impact point and is not a splash-radius claim.
The secondary build 18.600.3 may not exactly match the frozen 2026-09-17 target version. The primary source establishes behavior but not current numeric values.
conclusion: The ordinary Bowler is executable through shared Core, CLI, Viewer and RL paths with a sourced double impact. It remains partial until a versioned bounce path and splash contract are available.
